payload.title: Randomized long-horizon coefficient meta-learning
payload.statement: Thousands of legal mask tasks generated only from outer-training wells, with horizons spanning the real hidden-suffix distribution, can teach a mask-conditioned nonlinear coefficient predictor that transfers better than four fixed within-well pseudo-cut summaries.
payload.evidence_for: T025 proves pseudo coefficient dynamics are unique and useful: +0.125829 best aggregate gain, +0.200703 incremental value over the same-target E011-only comparator, and every corrupted control loses. The target oracle is 4.113743. Score-blind support analysis freezes 12,216 end-of-well tasks with median horizon 4,878 versus the real 4,840-row median.
payload.evidence_against: T025 fails spatial group 0 and typewell group 4. Random tasks can leak well identity, overweight repeated source wells, or learn horizon-specific artifacts unless outer isolation, per-well weighting, horizon balancing, and corrupted controls are exact.
